title: VTG Playboy Magazine September 1986 Rebekka Armstrong Complete With Centerfold
descriptionText: The product is a vintage Playboy Magazine from September 1986 featuring Rebekka Armstrong, including the centerfold. This collectible item showcases classic photography and articles from the iconic magazine, making it a desirable piece for fans and collectors of vintage Playboy magazines. With its nostalgic content and iconic Playboy brand, this magazine offers a glimpse into the popular culture and lifestyle of the 1980s.
